sources.excerpt: Crazy Tube Circuits Sidekick Jr. Multi-Effects Pedal Brand: Crazy Tube Circuits Compact Design: Fits easily on any pedalboard for space-saving convenience Classic 80s Effects: Combines modulation, delay, and reverb effects inspired by iconic stompboxes and rack units of the era Multiple Modulation Options: "Ensemble" for warm chorus, "Dimension" for enhanced 3D sound, and "Flanger" for a metallic, slow-chorus effect Tape and Digital Delays: Offers the sweet sounds of tape echo and pristine repeats of digital delay for versatile time-based effects Dual Reverb Banks: Select from classic reverbs like plate, spring, and hall (Bank A) or signature 80s sounds like gated, exciter, and shimmer (Bank B) Smart Switching: Delay and reverb operate independently, with modulation assignable to either section Optional Footswitch Expansion: XT footswitch (sold separately) allows independent on/off control for the modulation section Power-Up Bypass Preset: Choose the pedal's default state (on or off) when powering up for seamless integration with loopers and switchers True Bypass Switching: Maintains optimal signal integrity when effects are bypassed Perfect for 80s Genres: Ideal for creating jangly new wave, lush shoegaze, and soaking wet hair metal tones Show more › See more product details
